title: Settings in Both Pockets
description:
Guestbook’s theme and feature flags should not be baked into the image.

Create a ConfigMap and wire it in **two** ways: environment variables **and** a mounted file. Ops will check that the running app can see both forms — one pocket is not enough.

**Meant for:** ConfigMaps (env + volume).

problemStatement.brief: Create a ConfigMap and consume it as both environment variables and a mounted file — the app must see both.
